page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 4 vCPUs. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides entry-level GPU acceleration paired with dedicated CPU resources, offering a balanced hardware profile for workloads that require GPU processing without the high cost of larger accelerator models. This resource density makes it suitable for workloads such as low-latency inference, media transcoding, basic machine learning model deployment, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated computing.
